name: SLX 3×9 Rapidfire Plus shifter pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed complete left/right SL-M660 Rapidfire Plus shifter set, triple front and nine-speed rear, 256 g. The Shift Lever Set model column defines both front and rear controls. This is the complete mechanical shifter-set reference, not the separate BL-M665 brake-lever figure. Cable/housing inclusion is unspecified.
